Method of Attack: Encrypts designated file types and executes commands such as vssadmin to delete Shadow Volume Copies
Allows creation of ransomware executable via web builder with configurable options
Can be modified to download real ransom notes demanding ransom in bitcoins
Indicators of Compromise: Command & Parameter field used to download ransom note
Impacted Systems: Systems with files encrypted by ransomware executables created by ShinoLocker or derived ransomware
Attack Vector: Ransomware executable created via web-based builder
